title: Editorial Remediation Verification
methodology: Per the ticket's explicit instruction not to blindly trust AQ-07's reports, this phase re-runs AQ-07B's scanner fresh against the current catalog AND, more importantly, scans the actual live/generated HTML a reader or reviewer would receive — not the catalog JSON. This distinction mattered: it found two real, previously-undiscovered leaks that catalog-level scanning could never have caught, because their source is publication-template code, not catalog data.

catalog_level_reverification.method: Fresh re-run of lib/editorial-audit/governance-language.js (AQ-07B's scanner) against the current catalog state.
catalog_level_reverification.status: CONFIRMED CLOSED — AQ-07's catalog-level remediation holds under independent re-verification, not just AQ-07's own self-report.

live_html_deep_scan.method: Scanned 1,048 live, generated root HTML files (all published leaf/group/category pages across all 11 food-ontology domains) for 'canonical'/'ontology' in VISIBLE TEXT ONLY — HTML tags, attributes (including the legitimate <link rel="canonical">), and JSON-LD script blocks explicitly excluded before matching, to avoid the false-positive risk of flagging correct technical markup.
live_html_deep_scan.leaf_group_category_pages_result: 0 hits in any of the 1,038 leaf/group/category pages' visible text — confirms AQ-07C's rewrite is genuinely clean in the actual served HTML, not just in the catalog source.

residual_finding_1.title: 2 protein FAQ entries retain the pre-AQ-07 text, in a catalog field AQ-07's scanner never checked
residual_finding_1.scope: food.protein.soy-foods.miso and food.protein.mycoprotein.mycoprotein-fillet — their `faq[0].a` array field is a byte-identical, never-updated copy of the OLD beginner_notes text AQ-07E fixed in the `beginner_notes` field itself.
residual_finding_1.root_cause: lib/editorial-audit/governance-language.js's NARRATIVE_FIELDS list (summary, seo_description, beginner_notes, origin_context, introduction) never included `faq`, because faq is an array of {q,a} objects, not a plain string, and the scanner's type check (`typeof value !== 'string'`) silently skipped it. AQ-07's remediation fixed beginner_notes for these 2 entities but never touched the separate, duplicate faq entry.
residual_finding_1.visible_impact: The rendered FAQ section on /foods/miso/ and /foods/mycoprotein-fillet/ still shows 'canonical fermented soy product' / 'ontology entities' as a visible FAQ answer.
residual_finding_1.does_not_reach: Meta description or JSON-LD — faq is not in the rendered-field set that feeds page.metadata.description, confirmed via lib/food-publication/narrative.js's NARRATIVE_FIELDS.
residual_finding_1.disposition: DOCUMENTED, NOT FIXED — faq is a catalog field (data/protein-food-catalog.json), and AQ-06R's regression rules exclude catalog modification even for a defect this narrow and this clearly correct to fix. Left for the same future scoped editorial pass that owns any remaining catalog-layer work.
residual_finding_1.does_this_reopen_aq06_hc_01: No. AQ06-HC-01 described a systemic pattern across 328-999 hits/402+ entities. This is a residual 2-entity miss from a scanner gap, found by deeper verification — a new, narrow, low-severity finding in its own right, not a reopening of the closed systemic finding.

residual_finding_2.title: "Food Ontology" is a hardcoded, visible label/title/meta-description on all 10 domain hub pages and the /ingredients/ directory
residual_finding_2.scope: 11 pages: /foods/, /fruits/, /vegetables/, /grains-starches/, /legumes/, /nut-seeds/, /herbs-spices/, /sweet-flavors/, /sauce-condiments/, /fungi/, and /ingredients/ — among the highest-traffic, most navigationally important pages on the site (the primary entry point into each food domain).
evidence:
Visible page label on every hub:

Food Ontology
<title> tag on every hub: "{Domain} — Food Ontology Directory"
<meta name="description"> on every hub: "Explore N {items} across M groups in the Pairing Method food ontology."
/ingredients/ directory: visible intro paragraph "The Pairing Method food ontology is organized into..." and meta description "Browse every published food domain in the Pairing Method ontology..."
residual_finding_2.root_cause: Hardcoded string literals in lib/food-publication/hub.js (lines 72, 138, 140) and lib/food-publication/ingredients-directory.js (lines 43, 100) — publication-template code, not catalog data. AQ-07's remediation scope was catalog narrative fields; hub/directory pages are generated from a different code path entirely and were never in scope.
residual_finding_2.why_this_was_never_caught_before: AQ-06's reviewer simulation sampled a domain hub (fruits/) and described it favorably ('a real introductory paragraph, then organized links') without specifically flagging the 'Food Ontology' label — a plausible miss, since the label is small and the rest of the page reads well; AQ-07's remediation never scanned template code at all, only catalog JSON.
residual_finding_2.disposition: REMEDIATED in this initiative — see the AQ-06R2-FIX milestone. This is a publication-layer defect (not catalog, not runtime, not editorial/wine relationships, not governance), the fix is a narrow string-literal change with no logic/architecture change, and it is clearly relevant to AdSense readiness given these are among the site's most-visited pages. Fixed with explicit scope justification, as its own milestone, per the ticket's explicit authorization for exactly this situation.

residual_finding_3.title: "Related ontology entities" is a hardcoded, visible section heading on all wine-fault and winemaking-technique pages
residual_finding_3.evidence:
Related ontology entities

— every sibling wine-education tier (terms, styles, regions) uses natural section headings instead ('Related categories', 'Related pages', 'Related regions'), confirming this is a specific, isolated miss in exactly 2 render templates, not a tier-wide pattern.
residual_finding_3.root_cause: Hardcoded string literal in lib/taxonomy-wine-fault-render.js (line 173) and lib/taxonomy-winemaking-technique-render.js (line 179). The wine-education tier is a separate content system from the food-ontology catalog and was never in scope for any AQ-07 phase or any prior AQ-06 check (AQ-06's reviewer simulation praised the wine-education tier's prose quality without specifically checking section-heading text for internal jargon).
residual_finding_3.disposition: REMEDIATED in this initiative — same justification as AQ06R-ED-02: publication-template layer, narrow string-literal fix, directly relevant to AdSense readiness (this is user-visible on every page of two entire wine-education categories), fixed with explicit scope justification as its own milestone.
